resources.string: InstaGuard monitors Instagram foreground time to enforce a 1-hour active usage limit and 3-hour cooldown lock period for your digital wellbeing.
InstaGuard is actively protecting your screen time.
Complete the permission setup below to activate protection.
Allows querying precise Instagram foreground screen time.
Allows instant detection and lock screen enforcement when Instagram launches.
Enables impenetrable full-screen system overlays to completely block floating Picture-in-Picture windows.

If Android blocks Accessibility as a "Restricted setting":
1. Open Android Settings > Apps > InstaGuard.
2. Tap the ⋮ (three dots) in top-right corner.
3. Tap "Allow restricted settings" & authenticate.
4. Return here and tap "2. Enable Accessibility Service".
Usage timer and lock state have been reset.
